_meta.description: Unified manifest of all dietology knowledge base files. Each dataset entry includes domain, tier, sources, and provenance metadata.
_meta.provenance_guarantee: All values are from-source (numeric facts extraction from public sources). 0 fabrication, 0 recalculation. Every value traceable to original source document in data/external/.

dri-minerals-overlay.json.description: 14 minerals, 254 groups, finest granularity per source. 0 manual_transcription.
dri-minerals-overlay.json.notes: Ca: IOM 2011 (22 groups + ul_groups). P/Mg: IOM 1997 via NCBI cross-verification (22 groups each), UL from LPI (based on IOM 1997). Trace minerals: MSD Professional (16 groups each), UL from MSD Professional. Na/K: NAS 2019 (22 groups each). Pregnancy/breastfeeding split into teen/adult subgroups. All 14 nutrients have machine-verified UL metadata.

dri-vitamins-overlay.json.description: 11 vitamins, 154 groups, machine-parsed values with full metadata
dri-vitamins-overlay.json.notes: Values and metadata (unit, UL, ul_unit, ul_note, unit_note) all machine-extracted from MSD Professional HTML. 0 manual transcription. Pregnancy/breastfeeding are single groups without age split — MSD vitamins table does not provide teen/adult breakdown.

dri-macronutrients-per-kg-overlay.json.description: 3 nutrients (Ca/P/Mg), 51 groups (17 each), mg/kg of body weight
dri-macronutrients-per-kg-overlay.json.notes: Values machine-parsed; category/note/citation programmatically generated. 0 manual transcription. Per-kg values — model must multiply by individual body weight. More accurate for individual use than absolute DRI. Infants: AI. Children and adults: RDA. Based on IOM 1997.

usda-foundation-foods-essential.json.description: 363 foods with nutrient composition (per 100g), 27 essential nutrients
usda-foundation-foods-essential.json.notes: Subset of USDA Foundation Foods (CC0). Filtered to foods with complete nutrient profiles for 27 essential nutrients.

lab-reference-ranges.json.description: 254 lab test reference ranges across 16 categories
lab-reference-ranges.json.notes: Wikipedia-sourced reference ranges. Tier C: useful for context but not authoritative clinical reference. Values are population averages, not individual diagnostic thresholds.

who-hb-thresholds.json.notes: WHO 2024 Guideline on haemoglobin cutoffs. Includes severity classification (mild/moderate/severe), altitude/smoking adjustments, pregnancy-specific thresholds.

who-anaemia-nonpregnant-prevalence.json.description: Anaemia prevalence in non-pregnant women (15–49) by country, year, and severity — 20,950 records (242 countries, 1995–2019)
who-anaemia-nonpregnant-prevalence.json.notes: WHO GHO modelled estimates. Not raw survey data — statistical modelling for cross-country comparability. Values with 95% CI. CC BY 4.0.

who-bmi-overweight-prevalence.json.description: Prevalence of overweight (BMI ≥25) among adults 18+ by country, year, and sex — 20,790 records (210 countries, 1990–2022)
who-bmi-overweight-prevalence.json.notes: WHO GHO age-standardized estimates. Both-sex (BTSX), male (MLE), female (FMLE) breakdowns. Values with 95% CI. CC BY 4.0.

who-diabetes-prevalence.json.description: Age-standardized diabetes prevalence (raised fasting glucose ≥7.0 mmol/L or on medication) by country, year, sex, and age group — 41,580 records (210 countries, 1990–2022)
who-diabetes-prevalence.json.notes: WHO GHO age-standardized estimates. Age groups: 18+ and 30+. Sex breakdowns: BTSX, MLE, FMLE. Values with 95% CI. CC BY 4.0.

sources-final.json.description: Unified source manifest — definitive reference for all dietology data sources (15 sources, 5 tier levels)
sources-final.json.notes: Merges sources.json (base) + sources-overlay.json (DRI overlay) + data-index.json (catalog). Single authoritative source reference — model loads ONLY this file. Supersedes sources.json.
